versions.content: Non - SOME/IP - Services exist, that are not iden tified by a unique 16 Bit Service ID but a unique value of the key otherserv . These services use the Service ID 0xFFFE and must always carry a configuration option with an otherserv record. ECUs receiving an entry with Service ID 0xFFFE shall use the confi guration option and the otherserv record within in order to identify the relevant Service or Eventgroup configuration item.
